verdict.rationale: Google's Infrastructure Manager docs say you can define Google Cloud infrastructure declaratively using Terraform and preview changes before applying them. This shows first-party Terraform integration. However, nothing in the pack confirms a vendor-maintained provider, its release cadence, or which services it covers. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official Google-maintained Terraform/OpenTofu provider, active release history, coverage of core services, OpenTofu compatibility, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
